title: Reorder suggestions
description: How much to order, based on usage, supplier lead time and minimum stock.
forbidden: You need purchases and catalog read access to see reorder suggestions.
error: Reorder suggestions could not be loaded.
empty_hint: Every stock-tracked product looks fine. Turn on "Show all" to see every product.
select_hint: Select products to create drafts; you can change quantities in the row.
explain.title: How was this calculated?
explain.formula: Suggestion = daily usage × (lead time + target days) + minimum − stock − quantity on drafts; rounded up, to whole packs when a pack size is set.
drafts_dialog.title: Create purchase drafts?
drafts_dialog.description: {{products}} products become separate drafts for {{suppliers}} suppliers. Stock and cash do not change until a draft is approved.
drafts_dialog.missing_supplier: Pick a supplier for these products first: {{names}}
drafts.empty_hint: Select suggestions and choose "Create drafts"; one draft per supplier appears here.
post.title: Approve and post
post.description: The {{supplier}} draft is recorded as a purchase: stock goes up and the amount is booked as an expense on the chosen account.
post.hint: You can change the received quantity or the unit cost.
delete_draft.title: Delete the draft?
delete_draft.description: The draft is deleted permanently. Stock and cash are not affected.
settings.title: Reorder settings
settings.description: Periods used for the suggestions and the daily notification.
settings.velocity_hint: Quantities used on jobs and sold are averaged per day over this window.
settings.notify_hint: When products are out of stock or below the minimum, members with purchase access are notified every day at {{time}}.
settings.supplier_leads_hint: Suppliers not listed use the general lead time.
settings.validation.lead: Lead time must be between 0 and 180 days.
settings.validation.target: Target cover must be between 1 and 365 days.
override.title: Product reorder setting
override.description: Supplier, periods and pack size for {{name}}.
override.hint: Empty fields use the supplier and general settings.
override.validation.pack: Pack size must be greater than zero.
validation.qty: Quantities must be greater than zero.
validation.total: The purchase total must be greater than zero; enter unit costs.
